scientific_integrity: Fully symbolic arguments for all quantifiers; finite verifier provides regression evidence only. Earlier finite-prime asymptotics are credited, and no independent verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is only for the ordinary sum-of-divisors function and fixed sets of primes. It supplies an o(X^2) conclusion for the infinite critical set without a universal convergence rate. General weighted B-free mean-value coverage remains a bibliographic residual risk.
title: The full coefficient spectrum of generalized alternating divisor sums
